product.title: Wagvive Ear & Teeth Cleaning Wipes
product.body_html:
Two problems, one wipe.

Gentle, pre-moistened wipes formulated for both ears and teeth — perfect for dogs who tolerate a quick wipe far better than a full bath or brushing session. Removes wax, dirt, and debris from ears while helping cut down on plaque and everyday mouth odor, all in a fingertip-friendly design that makes cleanup quick and fuss-free.

  • Dual-purpose: ear care and dental care in one pack
  • Gentle, alcohol-free formula
  • Fingertip design for full control
  • 50 wipes per box
